variants.headline: Bid to remove government fails
variants.body: A vote to bring down the government has failed in {colony}. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Confidence challenge falls short
variants.body: The attempt to remove the government by an Assembly vote has failed. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.

variants.headline: Government survives the Assembly test
variants.body: The government has survived a vote intended to bring it down. Working people's needs belong at the centre of this discussion, rather than outside its political argument.
